value.syntax: # [doc = " Immutable view owned by a validated snapshot, distinct from unchecked candidates."] # [doc = " (´def:acts:carrier´)"] # [derive (Clone , Debug , PartialEq , Eq)] pub struct ValidatedAct { # [doc = " Opaque residues survive independent projection removal without interpretation."] commitments : Option < commitments :: ActCommitments > , # [doc = " Structural identity, containing the sole author and family representation."] id : ActId , # [doc = " Retained quantities, units, vintage and layout."] body : StructuralBody , # [doc = " All required legs together, with act-derived dependency status."] legs : Vec < ValidatedLeg > , # [doc = " Act-owned removable projections."] projections : RemovableProjections , # [doc = " Immutable required public references."] protocol_references : Vec < PublicReference > , # [doc = " Public evidence retained without cryptographic certification."] authentication_evidence : authentication :: AuthenticationFields , # [doc = " Finalization epoch, not identity."] finalization_epoch : u64 , # [doc = " Authoritative position, not identity."] authoritative_position : u64 , # [doc = " One retained time shared by all projections of this act."] logical_time : u64 , }
